ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: At 19:41 on the evening of April 20, 2017 Beijing time, "Tianzhou-1" was launched by the Long March 7 Y2 carrier rocket. After more than one day of flight, at 12:23 on April 22, the "Tianzhou-1" cargo spacecraft and the "Tiangong-2" space laboratory smoothly completed automatic rendezvous and docking. This was the first rendezvous and docking of "Tiangong-2" with a cargo spacecraft since it was launched into orbit on September 15, 2016. If after "Tianzhou-1" and "Tiangong-2" dock, their combination undergoes uniform circular motion at a distance r from the Earth's center. It is known that the period of uniform circular motion is T, the Earth's radius is R, and the gravitational constant is G. According to the known conditions in the question, which of the following statements is correct (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The problem states that the combined body undergoes uniform circular motion around the Earth's center, with orbital radius r and period T. The centripetal force is provided by universal gravitation: GMm/r^2 = m·4π^2r/T^2. Canceling m and rearranging gives the Earth's gravitational parameter GM = 4π^2r^3/T^2. The Earth's first cosmic velocity is the circular-motion speed close to the Earth's surface, with orbital radius R, satisfying v_1 = √(GM/R). Substituting GM = 4π^2r^3/T^2 gives v_1 = √(4π^2r^3/(T^2R)) = (2πr/T)√(r/R).
